dedupe_keys.name: cox s bazar health facility and service availability mapping for rohingya refugees and host communities march 2018 iscg hdx

description: This dataset lists health facilities serving Rohingya refugees and host communities in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, with their services, as mapped by the Inter Sector Coordination Group and the health sector in March 2018. Locations are GPS points collected by field enumerators. Coverage is the refugee camps and surrounding host communities of Cox's Bazar district. The table is free to download as an Excel file of about 180 kB from the Humanitarian Data Exchange, released into the public domain under Creative Commons Zero. Caveats: the snapshot dates from March 2018 while the note says the information was updated frequently at the time, the disclaimer states that it does not represent official UN or ISCG information, and inquiries are directed to the WHO health sector coordinator. Simulation uses: building a camp-scale health facility network for access, surge and cyclone or monsoon flood disruption analyses, and planning referral and ambulance routes in dense settlements. Related records: the IOM UAV imagery of the settlements (data-iom-npm-cox-bazar-rohingya-settlements-uav-imagery) and the Kutupalong camp fire evacuation case study (case_study-kutupalong-camp-fire-evacuation-simulation) cover the same camps.
